import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import tempfile
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
ART = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
HELPER = ROOT / "scripts" / "verify" / "has-kickoff-failure.py"
MUTATIONS = ROOT / "scripts" / "acceptance-hs-kickoff-mutations.sh"


def clean_env() -> dict[str, str]:
    return {
        key: value
        for key, value in os.environ.items()
        if not key.startswith("GIT_") and key not in {"BASH_ENV", "ENV"}
    }


def run_helper(log_text: str, expected: str) -> dict:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="hs0002-v2-blindspot-") as folder:
        log = Path(folder) / "out.log"
        log.write_text(log_text, encoding="utf-8")
        command = ["python3", str(HELPER), str(log), expected]
        started = datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()
        proc = subprocess.run(
            command,
            cwd=ROOT,
            env=clean_env(),
            text=True,
            capture_output=True,
            check=False,
        )
        ended = datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()
    return {
        "command": command,
        "started": started,
        "ended": ended,
        "exit_code": proc.returncode,
        "stdout": proc.stdout,
        "stderr": proc.stderr,
    }


def extract_callsite_expectations() -> list[str]:
    expectations = []
    for line in MUTATIONS.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        match = re.search(r"' '([^']+)'$", line)
        if match:
            expectations.append(match.group(1))
    return expectations


def main() -> int:
    before = hashlib.sha256(HELPER.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    expectations = extract_callsite_expectations()
    unique = sorted(set(expectations))
    probes = []

    for expected in unique:
        if expected in {"행 없음", "대상 칸에 다른 대상", "처분이 둘 이상"}:
            continue
        probes.append(
            {
                "id": f"prefix-bait:{expected}",
                "expected": expected,
                "wanted": 1,
                "log": f"FAIL: unrelated {expected} suffix",
                "result": run_helper(f"FAIL: unrelated {expected} suffix\n", expected),
            }
        )
        probes.append(
            {
                "id": f"word-extension:{expected}",
                "expected": expected,
                "wanted": 1,
                "log": f"FAIL: {expected}XYZ",
                "result": run_helper(f"FAIL: {expected}XYZ\n", expected),
            }
        )
        probes.append(
            {
                "id": f"canonical-boundary:{expected}",
                "expected": expected,
                "wanted": 0,
                "log": f"FAIL: {expected} — detail",
                "result": run_helper(f"FAIL: {expected} — detail\n", expected),
            }
        )

    probes.extend(
        [
            {
                "id": "space-only-expected",
                "expected": " ",
                "wanted": 1,
                "log": "FAIL:   x",
                "result": run_helper("FAIL:   x\n", " "),
            },
            {
                "id": "tab-only-expected",
                "expected": "\t",
                "wanted": 1,
                "log": "FAIL: \t details",
                "result": run_helper("FAIL: \t details\n", "\t"),
            },
            {
                "id": "raw-line-without-fail-prefix",
                "expected": "CI 배선 불량",
                "wanted": 1,
                "log": "CI 배선 불량 — raw diagnostic\nFAIL: unrelated",
                "result": run_helper("CI 배선 불량 — raw diagnostic\nFAIL: unrelated\n", "CI 배선 불량"),
            },
        ]
    )

    for probe in probes:
        probe["ok"] = probe["result"]["exit_code"] == probe["wanted"]

    after = hashlib.sha256(HELPER.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    report = {
        "purpose": "independent shared-blindspot attack beyond V1 scripts",
        "helper_sha256_before": before,
        "helper_sha256_after": after,
        "helper_unchanged": before == after,
        "callsite_expectation_count": len(expectations),
        "callsite_unique_expectations": unique,
        "probe_count": len(probes),
        "mismatches": [p["id"] for p in probes if not p["ok"]],
        "probes": probes,
    }
    (ART / "v2-shared-blindspot.json").write_text(
        json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    for probe in probes:
        status = "OK " if probe["ok"] else "BAD"
        print(
            f"{status} {probe['id'][:72]:72} want={probe['wanted']} got={probe['result']['exit_code']}"
        )
    print(
        "callsite expectations:",
        len(expectations),
        "unique:",
        len(unique),
        "mismatches:",
        report["mismatches"],
        "helper unchanged:",
        before == after,
    )
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
